# issuesmith

> Suite for agent-first software factories: Issue-to-merge production lines on ghdag.

## Docs

- [README.md](README.md)
- [Configuration](README.md#configuration)
- [CLI Reference](README.md#cli-reference)
- [Error Reference](README.md#error-reference)

## Schemas

- `issuesmith-config` — JSON Schema for `issuesmith.yaml` (`issuesmith config schema` prints it)

## CLI

Agent-oriented entry points (full command list: `issuesmith` with no args prints hints):

- `issuesmith queue status --json`
- `issuesmith andon list --json`
- `issuesmith milestone status`
- `issuesmith config show`
- `issuesmith config schema`
- `issuesmith doctor --json`
